raw_brief: Build a landing page for Haven, a secrets vault. Light.

surface.rendering: static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, offline file:// only, no CDN, no remote fonts/images, no network calls

product.name: Haven
product.category: secrets vault — credential and secret management for engineering teams
product.concept: Haven stores API keys, database credentials, certificates, and tokens encrypted at rest, and never hands the value itself to a person or service directly. Instead it issues short leases — scoped, time-boxed grants that expire on their own — and logs every one. A secret is always visible in shape (who owns it, when it expires, who last touched it); its value is only ever visible for the length of a lease.
product.why_this_reading: The brief supplies only a name and category, so a concrete identity has to be fixed to build a real page instead of an abstraction. 'Haven' denotes a place of shelter, not a padlock — that reading is honored by making the mechanism a lease you borrow and return, rather than a vault door you unlock and leave open. This is the director's decision, recorded here so it reads as intentional.

audience.primary: engineers, SREs, and security leads at small-to-mid engineering orgs currently passing secrets through .env files, Slack DMs, or a shared password doc
audience.mindset_on_arrival: wary of another dashboard to babysit; needs to see the actual mechanism (how a lease is requested, granted, and expired) before trusting a vendor with credentials
audience.technical_fluency: high — comfortable with CLI, env vars, IAM/role terminology; copy can assume this

outcome.business_goal: drive self-serve signups for a security/infra product
outcome.secondary_action: See a lease in the docs

action.conversion_shape: single above-the-fold CTA pair, restated once at page end; no pricing page in scope (out of scope per brief brevity)

taste_targets.layout: mid-high — mostly grid-aligned with deliberate breaks (asymmetric hero, offset principle band); precise, not playful — a vault's composition should read exact
taste_targets.typography: mid-high — one modular scale (ratio 1.333), system-ui sans for display/body (no remote fonts permitted), mono reserved for secret values, lease IDs, and the access-log specimen
taste_targets.spacing: mid, airy on marketing bands (base unit 8px) collapsing to tight/dense inside the lease-card and access-log specimens — the marketing breathes, the product is exact
taste_targets.motion: mid — restrained entrance and hover feedback only, plus one purposeful device: a countdown ring that visibly depletes on the hero specimen; no orchestrated/expressive motion; full prefers-reduced-motion fallback
taste_targets.iconography: mid — one hand-authored line-icon family, 24px grid, 1.75px stroke, used sparingly for lock/key/lease/audit concepts
taste_targets.depth: low-mid — mostly flat light surfaces with a small elevation ramp (paper / card / raised), tinted soft shadows, no glass
taste_targets.consistency: not scorable — first generation, no established project design system to inherit from

out_of_scope: auth flows (sign in / sign up forms beyond the CTA)
blog, changelog, or docs content beyond a single illustrative specimen
real third-party logos or named customers (would require unverifiable brand/identity claims)
